Featured Showcase is a single continuous image - any height works, it's just resized to 630px wide.

Background picture

-


Steam shows a static background at its native size, centered - it's not scaled to fit, so aim for ~1920×1080 (narrower gets black bars, wider is clipped by the window). An animated background is always shown 1920px wide. The preview above is the real thing - the avatar and showcases sit on top of it.

Slice for showcases

Cuts the exact piece of the background each showcase covers, so the profile reads as one seamless picture. List your showcases top to bottom in the same order as your profile, then upload each piece as that showcase's image (see the upload guide).

    Don't forget to maximize your browser window. This method relies on the Steam profile style.






    "Disable slider" is on by default (crops the whole image). Uncheck it to drag the slider and pick a specific slice instead.

    WARNING: Image is too small. Make sure that your image is at least width of 626 pixels, and height of 122 pixels.
    You can crop the image with it's original size, but it'll look small on the showcase.

    Every exported image is auto-hexified (last byte rewritten to 0x21) before zipping, so it renders at full size on Steam. Not sure how to upload it? See the upload guide.
